text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Flash's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Wow, the crowd is in a frenzy! Is this how
all
Japan's G1 races are?

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
This race seems to have a rich history.
Can you
believe our beloved Schatzi is
running in it?

text_block_list.name: Flash's Mother
text_block_list.text: Mm... Good luck, Flash!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It seems my parents have arrived safely
at the
venue.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Everything is unfolding perfectly, and I
am in
good condition. Now all I must do
is carry out my
plans and...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Right...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I have a favor to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Please observe today's race alongside
my parents.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will come and find you all after the
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Mother and Father are somewhere
within that
roaring crowd.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(I decided to complete all these races
because I
wanted to become someone
the two people I
admire most in this
world could be proud of.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(I believe that to be "right." But... my
image of
that truth has changed.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(After meeting Trainer and
comprehending my
own shortcomings, I
acquired a new perspective.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(During the Derby, a fire was lit in my
heart, and I
learned that my tenacity is
the key to grasp
victory.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(The racers of the Ultimate Era are
formidable, to
the extent I considered
forfeiting my plan.
However...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(I had people who were there to tell me
that I am
more than my shortcomings.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (The "truth" I have come to possess...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Is who I am at this moment.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(I've changed since the day I bid
farewell to my
parents and left for
Japan.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will prove how far I have come. To
Father, to
Mother... and to you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Auf geht's! It's time to put my pride on
the line!
